subject: *: fix a bug that update statement uses point get and update plan with different tblInfo (#54183)
summary: Reviewed `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go` diff vs first parent. Change tightens plan-cache preprocessing by treating per-table `Revision` drift (between current InfoSchema table and the table used for MDL locking) as a schema mismatch, forcing re-preprocess to refresh table refs and avoid mixed `tblInfo` between PointGet and Update planning under MDL/schema-state changes. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner scope for this commit.
